newsitem.title: USA: Barnett Banks extends exchange offer.
newsitem.headline: Barnett Banks extends exchange offer.

text.p: Barnett Banks Inc has extended its deadlines for an exchange offer for two series of capital securities to 1700 EDT, June 18, 1997.

The capital securities are being exchange for like amounts of the securities that are registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission, so they could be traded on exchanges, a company spokesman said.
The capital securities are treated as capital by regulators, but the interest paid to holders is tax deductible by the company, giving the securities an advantage to the issuer over preferred stock.

Barnett Banks said in a statement that the exchange offer's expiration date was extended for $200 million of Barnett Capital II's 7.95 percent capital securites and $250 million of Barnett Capital III's floating rate capital securities.
As of June 13, 1997, approximately $165.65 million of the original Barnett Capital II securities and $215 million of the original Barnett Capital III securities were exchanged.
